schema_documentation:
12 keys, two variants: 1,205,575 records key the text as `text`; 6,096 key it as `speech` whose value is always null.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `member_name` | str | 100% | speaker full name, lowercase unaccented; literal `"nan"` in ~46,950 |
| `sitting_date` | str | 100% | `DD/MM/YYYY` |
| `parliamentary_period` | str | 100% | `"period 5"`…`"period 17"` |
| `parliamentary_session` | str | 100% | `"session 1"`, `"2010 summer recess section 1"` |
| `parliamentary_sitting` | str | 100% | `"sitting 3"` |
| `political_party` | str | 100% | lowercase party name |
| `government` | **list[str]** | 100% | always length 1, e.g. `['τζαννετακη τζαννη(02/07/1989-12/10/1989)']` |
| `member_region` | str | 100% | electoral district or `"nan"` |
| `roles` | **list[str] OR str** | 100% | list of role strings (95.1% of sampled) or the bare string `"nan"` (4.9%) — type-unstable, guard for it |
| `member_gender` | str | 100% | male / female / nan |
| `speaker_info` | str | 100% | role while speaking, e.g. `"προεδρευων"`, `"βουλευτης/ες"` |
| `text` | str | 99.44% (1,205,575) | the speech |
| `speech` | null | 0.56% (6,096) | always None |
